courses.overview: 由自容、互容與抗干擾判讀延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend self/mutual capacitance and interference discrimination into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 電子紙顯示驅動系統
related.why: 電子紙與觸控可整合成低功耗閱讀介面。
related.whyEn: E-paper and touch can form a low-power reading interface.
related.transfer: 電子紙與觸控可整合成低功耗閱讀介面。
related.transferEn: E-paper and touch can form a low-power reading interface.
related.difference: 雙穩態顯示不代表觸控掃描零功耗。
related.differenceEn: A bistable display does not make touch scanning energy-free.
practice: 把「自電容」的概念圖與「電子紙顯示驅動系統」的輸入輸出對照。
對照不同走線長度的基線與噪聲。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：雙穩態顯示不代表觸控掃描零功耗。
practiceEn: Compare the self capacitance concept map with inputs/outputs of Electronic-paper display drivers.
Compare baseline/noise for different trace lengths.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: A bistable display does not make touch scanning energy-free.

related.title: 工業感測器隔離通訊
related.why: 工業感測與觸控都需要對抗共模與電源干擾。
related.whyEn: Industrial sensors and touch both face common-mode/supply interference.
related.transfer: 工業感測與觸控都需要對抗共模與電源干擾。
related.transferEn: Industrial sensors and touch both face common-mode/supply interference.
related.difference: 触控的電場和基線模型不同於差動數位匯流排。
related.differenceEn: Touch fields/baselines differ from differential digital buses.
practice: 把「互電容」的概念圖與「工業感測器隔離通訊」的輸入輸出對照。
比較三種掃描時間的 SNR 和回應延遲。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：触控的電場和基線模型不同於差動數位匯流排。
practiceEn: Compare the mutual capacitance concept map with inputs/outputs of Isolated communications for industrial sensors.
Compare SNR/latency at three scan durations.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Touch fields/baselines differ from differential digital buses.

courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，保留本課的基本模型，重新核對材料、規模、環境與驗收邊界。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Infineon 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。自容感測觀察電極對環境的電容改變。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「自容、互容與抗干擾判讀」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Infineon provides a traceable starting point. Self-capacitance senses electrode-to-environment change. Independently authored models connect this to self/mutual capacitance and interference discrimination; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：不同按下釋放門檻可降低閾值附近抖動。 以「給定接近閾值的雜訊序列計算狀態轉換。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: Different press/release thresholds reduce chatter near a boundary. Practice interpretation using: Compute state transitions for noisy near-threshold data. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
